phase_name: Flakiness Decision Gate -- 3 Repeated Parallel Runs

objectives.description: Run the full suite 3 times at --jobs 4, capturing --timings and pass/fail sets
objectives.note: Two attempts made. Attempt 1 (2/3 runs completed) revealed test-run-all-parallel.sh flaking on its own case3 -- see objective 2. Attempt 2 (1/3 runs completed, using the interim serialization-only fix) was interrupted: the harness's idle-session memory-pressure safeguard killed the background task because system-wide memory was genuinely low from unrelated concurrent sessions/builds (confirmed via free -h/ps aux, not transient -- swap usage 17-19 GiB of 31 GiB both before and after). No 3-run batch has completed against the FINAL code (serialization + relative-ratio redesign, both committed). This is an environmental constraint, not a task defect.

objectives.description: Diagnose and fix a real flake found along the way: test-run-all-parallel.sh case3
objectives.note: Root cause: genuine ambient HOST load from unrelated concurrent processes (other Claude sessions, pytest, lean4lean builds), not sibling-suite contention within run-all.sh's own pool (confirmed: serializing the suite alone did NOT fix the flake in a follow-up run). Fix: redesigned case3/case4 from absolute-ms thresholds to a load-tolerant relative ratio (parallel <= 75% of forced-sequential, measured back-to-back). Verified 9/9 standalone. Committed as 'task 261 phase 6.1'.

objectives.description: Diff against Phase 1 baseline, inspect load-sensitive set, apply gate criterion
objectives.note: Blocked on objective 1 completing a clean 3-run batch against the final code.

approaches_tried.reason: Interrupted by the harness's idle-session memory-pressure reap on the 2nd attempt (1/3 runs completed). System memory was genuinely low from unrelated concurrent sessions, confirmed via free -h (17-19 GiB/31 GiB swap used) both before and after -- not resolved by waiting. Per the harness's own guidance, do not blindly restart the same pattern; a successor dispatch should check free -h first and prefer a foreground/blocking call with a generous timeout.

deviations.description: Run the full suite 3 times at the chosen job count
deviations.reason: System-wide memory pressure from unrelated concurrent processes interrupted both attempts; only 2/3 and then 1/3 runs completed per attempt. Deferred to a successor dispatch.
